_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "hex_color" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_project_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "position" REAL NOT NULL, "owner_id" INTEGER NULL, "created" INTEGER NULL, "updated" INTEGER NULL, "max_permission" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_views" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "project_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" REAL NOT NULL, "filter_json" TEXT NULL, "bucket_configuration_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_bucket_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "done_bucket_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labels" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "hex_color" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by_id" INTEGER NULL, "created" INTEGER NULL, "updated" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "project_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "done_at" INTEGER NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL, "percent_done" REAL NOT NULL, "hex_color" TEXT NOT NULL, "identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "position" REAL NOT NULL, "repeat_after" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repeat_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bucket_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by_id" INTEGER NULL, "created" INTEGER NULL, "updated" INTEGER NULL, "comment_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_unread" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_unread" IN (0, 1)), "sync_run_id" TEXT NULL, "pending_changes" TEXT NULL, "pending_delete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_delete" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_labels" ("task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES labels (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "label_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_assignees" ("task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "user_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_reminders" ("task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reminder" INTEGER NULL, "relative_period" INTEGER NOT NULL, "relative_to" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "ordinal"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_relations" ("task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "other_task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "other_task_id", "kind"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "sent_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_id_remaps" ("local_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_notifications" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "os_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "fire_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "snoozed_until" INTEGER NULL, "snooze_original_fire_at" INTEGER NULL, "exact" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("exact" IN (0, 1)), "hidden_on_lock_screen" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden_on_lock_screen" IN (0, 1)), "done_needs_unlock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done_needs_unlock" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "server_notifications" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created" INTEGER NOT NULL, "read_at" INTEGER NULL, "read_pending" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("read_pending" IN (0, 1)), "notified" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("notified" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "list_snapshots" ("list_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "loaded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("list_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "list_snapshot_tasks" ("list_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" REAL NOT NULL, "bucket_id" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("list_key", "task_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "list_preferences" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kanban_buckets" ("view_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bucket_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "limit" INTEGER NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" REAL NOT NULL, "loaded_pages" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("view_id", "bucket_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "imported_widget_actions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX project_views_project ON project_views (project_id)
CREATE INDEX tasks_project ON tasks (project_id)
CREATE INDEX tasks_done_due ON tasks (done, due_date)
CREATE INDEX outbox_state_sequence ON outbox (state, sequence)
